chapters: Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Ramataim gu Sopim gu kavɨk gu Epraim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Elkana gu mar gu Jeroam gu mar gu Eliuu gu mar gu Tou gu mar gu Sup gu Eprateo.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gook gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Anna gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Peninna; mi' dhɨr gu Peninna ga'ra' gu ma'nkam gu' gu Anna cham ga'ra'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kiicham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Silo pai' mi'p gook gu ma'nkam gu Eli gu Opni gu Pinees jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu tanoolh gu Elkana maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Peninna gu u'vɨ bɨx gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ maa'n baasɨ'n.

Gu' gu' gu Anna guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ baasɨ'n guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; na gu' dha'da' gu Anna guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam oidha' tas; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Elkana gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu Anna guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ cham tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' tutkɨ mambhɨɨx gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Anna mi' dhɨr ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Silo; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eli ka't daakat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' jix duu tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ja'tkam na tu juan tu' tu jiim tu' cham tu' cham jix maat ja'tkam na tu juan gu' tu jiim ja'tkam na tu juan gu mar gu chio'ñ tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Eli ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu chin.

Gu' gu' gu Anna ua'rgidhimɨk gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Eli guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Eli; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk dhi' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm suudai' u'va.

Jano' ba' gu Anna jix aa' bham; gio ba' cham gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gu' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ; jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios suudai' u'va tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat vaak na jix bhaan gu i'ii'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ja'tkam na tu juan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jano'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eli; gio ba' tu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ja'tkam na tu juan nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan gu vupui; mi' dhɨr ka't gu u'vɨ gu bhóogɨt jix jugi cham juruuñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix duu.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu xibh o'lhia vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios suulh tɨɨtɨs gu vaak gu Ramata; gio ba' gu Elkana guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Anna gu u'vɨ gu Jawatan Dios tɨ'ñcho.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Anna guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu mar jix dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Samueel bham; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ gu chio'ñ gu Elkana bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam vaak maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Anna cham jix tɨ'ɨ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu chio'ñ; gio ba' tu' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Jano' ba' gu Elkana gu chio'ñ jix aa'; gio ba' gu vupui xoi'kam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu u'vɨ jix duu gu mar bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ baidhak bɨɨx vaik ali' vaakax gu Epa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Silo; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't jix ali'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tuur aichdhak guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Eli.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ juruuñ ju'ñdharan tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios jix maa guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gio gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨx gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Anna guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu chin guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tulhiiñdha'.

Jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch jix bhaan na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ mai' tu'; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha'.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ a'gi'ñchu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu chin; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx maachim gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix duu guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' u'u gat jix kavɨk jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu takarui'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm tu jiim kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ga'ra' mui'x gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix maa gu oidha'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tukga'n guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam oo' gampai' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' tu jiim bɨɨx chiñia'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ nɨidhat; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan oipichu'.
Jano' ba' jix nukadham tɨɨt jɨɨgi'ñdham gu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tukgam; na gu' soo'mchulhdhak ka't jix kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu kavɨk.

Jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios dɨr gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu oidha' maa'n gu kavɨk gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Mesiias.
Jano' ba' gu Elkana guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak gu Ramata; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eli.
Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Eli guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa cham ko'kmarak machia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx gu ja'tkam ka't na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix duu jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu chuukug ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu novɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaik guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr dhi' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx gu Israelita guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Silo.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam va'k guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix duu jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan chɨtda maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan; gio ba' jix maa gu chuukug guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' gu chuukug guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Kuemen guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ja'p tu jiim; gio ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jano' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' ka't uañi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Samueel guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tɨi'chu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu naan kutun na jix toja guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ oidha' tas na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu maa'nkar tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eli jix bhai' aa' gu Elkana gu u'vɨ bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu kai' dhi' gu u'vɨ pai' dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix duu gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr suulh gu vaak.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu Anna guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vaik gu ma'nkam gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Samueel gɨ'lhidha' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Eli cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix kai bɨx gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx gu Israeel na ja'p guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Ba' jix aa'; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim xoi'kam tu'x tuutu'm na gu' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam tomaat tu jiim.

Jano' ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ koko'kam gook gu ma'nkam gu Eli gu Opni gu Pinees.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu chio'ñ gu Benjamiin suudai' u'va mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Silo guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jajannulhi'ñ gu oidha' bhaan mo'o.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Eli ka't daakat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ju'ñdharan gu bhóogɨt; na gu' gu i'ii'ñ ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuiñcha kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu jiim mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ kiicham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨx kiicham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Eli jix kai guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix maa guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Eli.

Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu Eli guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu vupui guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Eli; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' mattuda'; gio ba' gu Israeel guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan gu Pilisteos gio ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gio gook gu ma'nkam gu Opni gu Pinees koko'kam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix duu ka't na ja'p guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Eli guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix koi; na gu' ka't gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Israeel oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu u'vɨ gu Pinees ka't gu ja'tkam mia'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tɨiñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ koko'kam jir bɨx bhai' gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' vaak na jix bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios am:―Ja'pji mi'p ju'ñdharan; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam choo'n na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu mar; gu' cham jix aa' tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Ikâbod bham; na gu' bhaan gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na gu' ka't jix koi jir bɨx bhai' gu chio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' bhaan gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Israeel; na gu' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios aichdhak dɨr gu Eben-eser gu Asdod.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Pilisteos kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vaak gu Dagoon jix dhaas ju'ñdharan gu Dagoon.

Jano' ba' buimgidhak gu tanoolh gu Asdod jix búup gu xibh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Dagoon guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu oidha' vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dagoon suulh pai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu xibh buimgidhak gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Dagoon ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu oidha' vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' mo'o gu Dagoon gook guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu noobh mi'p guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Dagoon guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' kuiñcha jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Dagoon bɨx vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Dagoon ba'k cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dagoon gu Asdod bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Asdod guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' naaka'n bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Asdod bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ dhi' gu Asdod gui'p; na gu' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx no'ch kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel na gu' gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhaan no'ch bhaan chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu Dagoon.

Jano' ba' mɨjɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx chiñia' gu Pilisteos gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim chulhiiñchuda' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu Gat; jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p a'lhiok guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan kiicham bɨɨx jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' tu' naaka'n gu chichio'ñ mii' dhɨr kiicham dɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx ka'm jix gɨ' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' mɨjɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Ekroon; gio ba' na ja'p kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va gu Ekroon gu Ekronitas jix maa jiiñak bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kooda' tu' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' mɨjɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx chiñia' gu Pilisteos bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' gu ja'tkam; na gu' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ koi'm bɨx kiicham gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' tu ñi'ook kiicham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' gu Estubo kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu Pilisteos kɨɨv masaa'n.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tɨkka; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim chulhiiñchuda' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Deklaradnos gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨip pai'.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; jano' ba' boopoya' dudua'ñdha' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham jix ai'chdhix guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu ñi'ook; na gu' jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' chiñia' gu Pilisteos jixchamaam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix uam jodai jixchamaam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix uam jodai na gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx namki' gio chiñia'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu novɨ bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu oidha'.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p gu Egipkios gu Faraoon guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu i'ii'ñ mi' dhɨr ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhaai'n jix bɨɨx duu.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jano' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix vɨɨk guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gook guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ali' vaakax gu vaak.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' gu Bet-semes tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi' cham bhai' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix gɨ'; mi' dhɨr tu' cham duduaka' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu novɨ cham naaka'n tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jix duu; na gu' dhaagɨk gook guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu vaak ali' vaakax.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix uam jodai bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt gu Bet-semes tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham tu jiim tu' kɨɨ'n tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' chiñia' gu Pilisteos jix bɨɨx duu bhaan bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu Bet-semes.

Jano' ba' gu Bet-semes guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tiriik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vupui guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios suudai' u'va yooxi' gu Josuee gu Bet-semita tu jiim; na gu' ka't gu jodai; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu u'u guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Lebitas tɨsaa'ñdhak kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't ju'ñdharan mi'p guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix uam jodai jix dhaas bhaan mii' dhɨr gu jodai; gio ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Bet-semes maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ jixchamaam chiñia' gu Pilisteos suulh gu Ekroon gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Pilisteos gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Asdod guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Gasa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Askaloon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Gat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Ekroon.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix uam jodai jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jixchamaam chiñia' dɨr jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk bɨɨx ka'm taañpu' cham vaak jodai; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai bhaan jix dhaas kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai yooxi' gu Josuee gu Bet-semita bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Na gu' jano' ba' naaka'n gu Jawatan Dios gu Bet-semes na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' naaka'n gu ja'tkam mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chichio'ñ; na gu' gu ja'tkam jix dhaas guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu Bet-semes; gio ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan chɨkka guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dɨr no'ch.

Jano' ba' mɨjɨ jix duu gu Kîriat-jearim bham; gio ba' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Kîriat-jearim bhɨɨk kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vaak gu Abinadab guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Eleasar gu mar na ba' jix nukadham kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ka't dɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Kîriat-jearim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mui'x gu tanoolh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel bham; gio ba' tu' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Astarot tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu novɨ gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Baales gu Astarot guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx gu Israeel gu Mispa tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Mispa guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu suudai' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gui'p; gio ba' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ uañi'ñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Samueel gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Mispa.

Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Pilisteos gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mi'p guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Mispa guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa chiñia' gu Pilisteos bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p a'lhiok naak gu ma'nkam gu Israeel chooto'n choo'n gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' gui'p gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Samueel; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm no'ch gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu novɨ gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' gu Samueel jix bhɨɨ mar kaneer bii'm maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Samueel gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios jix kai.

Jano' ba' ka't kua' gu Samueel maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨɨx jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bhaan gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vupui bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gamai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Mispa bhiadat gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Bet-kar.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Samueel gu jodai jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Mispa gu Sen jix dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Eben-eser bham; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ cham tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu oidha' gu Israeel; gio ba' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu Pilisteos bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Samueel.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jɨ'dɨlh gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Israelitas dɨr gu Ekroon bɨɨx ka'm gu Gat bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' tu' gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu novɨ gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel gu Amorreo.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Samueel gu Israeel bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix oidha'.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Bet-el gu Gilgal gu Mispa guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Israeel bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix duu.
Na gu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ mi' dhɨr gu Rama na gu' ka't gu vaak guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Israeel; gio ba' pai'x jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't dhaibu gu Samueel guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix dhaas gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu mar maa'nkam mar ka't gu Joel gu tɨɨgɨ' gook gu Abia; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Beer-seba.

Gu' gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt gu taat va'k guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix duu.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx daraa gu Israeel jum daa'ñ tɨɨtɨs gu Samueel gu Rama.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu ma'nkam cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jano' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chɨbɨɨp.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Samueel dhi' gu ñi'ook gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr gu Samueel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Samueel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bɨx tu' tu ñi'ook; na gu' cham tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' cham gu gɨ'kora' bhaan.

Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ buimɨi guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨtda:―Cha'pim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ xoi'kam gio bɨndak.
Jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook; gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix duu gu gɨ'kora' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' ka't jix duu gu gɨ'kora' bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam kavaayo na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mambhɨɨx; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga vaak ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat xoi'kam gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gio ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix duu guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu jiim maa'n tu duukam.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx gu kai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu duukam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu duukam ja'tkam na tu juan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ biipibop buur bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam buimɨi.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx gio kakneer boopoya' tu duukam.
Jano' ba' duuñ mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh kuiñcha gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ja'tkam cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Samueel; gio ba' va'k gui'p; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' bhaan no'ch.

Jano' ba' no'ch duduaka' gio na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chɨbɨɨp chulhiiñdha' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga vupui bhaan no'ch guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Samueel guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat maatɨt gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Samueel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu gɨ'kora' bhaan; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix aa' gu Samueel gu chio'ñ gu Israeel; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ maa'n kiicham.

Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Benjamiin gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Kis gu mar gu Abiel gu mar gu Seor gu mar gu Bekôra gu mar gu Apia gu mar gu chio'ñ gu Benjamiin.

Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu mar guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Sauul biapma' tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu jiim; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jiix daam no'x gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' dua'ñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim buur gu Kis gu taat gu Sauul; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix aa' gu Kis gu Sauul gu mar; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jano' bɨndak oi'ñdha' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bamii' tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ buur.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu oidha' gu Salisa cham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' gu Saalim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' gu Benjamiin cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk tɨɨtɨs gu oidha' gu Sup gu Sauul jix duu ga'ra' baidhak; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu taat tɨtda:―Cha'pim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat buur guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm no'ch.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jano' cham tu'x jai'ch dhi' kiicham gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x tu ñi'ook cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga aajim; jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat chulhiiñdha' gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu'.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix aa' jix duu; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jano'; na gu' gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu chio'ñ na gu' gu takarui' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' gu ñi'ook cham tañia' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tañia'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix duu tu ñi'ook gu Sauul bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bakia' gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ baasɨ'n guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix toja jodai; na gu' dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam chulhiiñdha' gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Israeel no'x guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios chɨtda; gio ba' jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; na gu' jano' mɨmɨim jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka't tɨɨgim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul jix duu; gio ba' xoi'kam tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu kiicham pai' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn kiicham gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu suudai' gui'p; gio ba' dhi' pai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gui'p; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios vupui bhaan tu'; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' tɨbiap kiicham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam juraa'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ba'k kiicham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios va'k guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jugi; na gu' gu ja'tkam cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx ka'm ka't tɨbiap na gu' ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu maa'nkar mi' dhɨr jugi koi'cham; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jano' na gu' jano' chɨɨmɨlhdhapu'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa kiicham; na pai' dhuuk tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Samueel vupui bhaan busaak na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh va'k gu Sauul guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ naak gu Samueel bham.

Jano' ba' gu xibh dhi' gu tas tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' gu chio'ñ gu oidha' gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel u'ua'tɨda' gu ja'tkam gu novɨ gu Pilisteos; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ja'tkam na gu' tu ñi'ook tu' tu jiim bɨɨx ka'm tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel jix ñi' gu Sauul gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Miren guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu chio'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam aapi' gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Sauul gu Samueel tɨjɨɨ'ñ ki'ñgob; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat duukat gu vaak guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; mi' dhɨr tu jiim vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xibh tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.

Na gu' buur tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' vaik gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gaagam; gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chɨkka bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu vaak gu taat.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' gu mar gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bopxi'ñ gu Israeel ja'tkam vaak cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn nɨidhim.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Samueel gu Sauul jix duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix maa pai' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios koi'cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ja'p guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu chichio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' tu ñi'ook nuuka'n dɨlhkob.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx ka't bhaan jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Sauul; gio ba' gu Samueel jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; na pai' dhuuk na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' tu' na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' amuub gu ja'tkam; jano' ba' gu Sauul jix jugi mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨɨx gu Samueel.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk a'lhiok guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ kiicham bɨɨx gu Sauul guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Samueel jup tɨɨt gu Sauul ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' bamii' na ba' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' jix búup gu Sauul moor mai' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Samueel.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kiicham gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim vupui bhaan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' dhaagɨk jano' ba' gu Samueel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨ'ñdhatu' ja'aa bhaan mo'o guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' cham tu' Xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ mi' dhɨr tu' cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' bakia' gook gu chichio'ñ ju'ñdharan tukga'n gu Rakêl gu oidha' gu Benjamiin gu Selsa tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' buur guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gaagam; mi' dhɨr gu taat tu' tɨtda:―Cha'pim tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn buur tu' xoi'kam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bham; jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu mar.

Jano' ba' na ja'p tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix duu vaak ja'tkam gu Tabor tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vaik gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu Bet-el guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ maa'n vaik chiiw vaik guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu takarui' vaik gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tulhiiñdha' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gook gu takarui' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu noobh.

Jano' ba' ɨlhdham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios pai' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Pilisteos; na pai' dhuuk baakɨi kiicham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ chu'p jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨɨx ka' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu chio'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa daam dhi' buimɨk gu vupui tu' daraibu' gu novɨ na gu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vupui bhaan tu' gu Gilgal; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' na ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kɨɨv gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' jix duu gu Samueel guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' buimɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chu'p jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix ai bɨɨx gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ñi'ook va'k guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ja'p guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ja'tkam chɨtda maa'n; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu mar gu Kis gu Sauul gio tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' oi'ñdha'; gio ba' chɨkka gu taat gu Por dhi' kuiñcha guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; mi' dhɨr gio gu Sauul tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix utu'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Sauul jix duu; gio ba' duukat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ buur; jano' ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Samueel.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Sauul; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ jix duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix aa' gu Samueel.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix aa' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios buur guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Samueel ka't tu ñi'ook cham jix ñi'ñ cham tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Samueel guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios gu Mispa.

Ba' jix aa' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Israeel gu Ejipto guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu novɨ gu Egipkios gu novɨ bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios jix nukadham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tulhiiñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu gɨ'kora' bhaan no'ch; mi' dhɨr jano' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix duu.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Samueel guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ja'tkam vaak gu Matri; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Sauul gu mar gu Kis; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu' cham ka't gaagam.

Jano' ba' tɨkka tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam dɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jiix ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨx gu ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ buupui tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios cham cham tu'x jai'ch nɨidhim bɨx gu ja'tkam jano' ba' gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Samueel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam jix duu oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ua'na u'uan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Samueel bɨx gu ja'tkam maa'n gu vaak; gio ba' gu Sauul gio ka't gu vaak gu Gabaa jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't dhaa.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam chooto'n guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cham aichdhak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Naas gu Ammonita guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' bhaan gu Jabes gu Galaad; gio ba' bɨx gu Jabes gui'p gu Naas; mi' dhɨr gu vupui ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx no'ch tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Naas gu Ammonita jix aa'; gio ba' bɨɨx dhi' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat maa'n bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix duu guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan bɨx gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' daraa gu Jabes gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios kɨɨv gu tanoolh na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix duu bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' soo'mchulhdhak bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix duu gu Gabaa gu Sauul gui'p dhi' gu ñi'ook maatɨt gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Sauul guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn yooxi' bhaan gu vaakax; gio ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim juraa'n gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu Jabes.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Sauul tɨiñ dhi' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' dhaagɨk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaakax guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhañ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ jix duu bham; gio ba' no'x cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Sauul guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Samueel ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu vaakax; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn choo'n gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ja'tkam moor na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Besek; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jix duu guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨbiap; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jabes gu Galaad; mi' dhɨr gu xibh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu tas gui'x dodhia'; jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs jix duu gu Jabes guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu Jabes gui'p; gio ba' gu xibh guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx no'ch bɨx xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Sauul gu ja'tkam vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ baap tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak ja'tkam tu jiim gu xibh tu' jix duu gu Ammonitas bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu jiim cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gook tɨtda:―Aañ.
Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam jano' ba' gu Samueel; gio ba' chɨkka am:―Ja'pji; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Sauul bhaan no'ch gu Dad guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu chichio'ñ kooda'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha' gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Samueel gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Gilgal na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' ka't bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Gilgal tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Sauul guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Gilgal; gio ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jix jai' gu Sauul bɨx gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' naak gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' tu' vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gu' gu ma'nkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' dhi'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan tu' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan Xoi'kam tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaakax oi'ñdha' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam buur oi'ñdha' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn oi'ñdha' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't jix bhaan dhaas gu vupui; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu chio'ñ.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ookdham bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat Xoi'kam gio ñi'ookdham dhi' gu tanoolh cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gaagam gu novɨ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn matgɨm; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; jano' ba'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu Moisees gu Aaroon jix buusñi tattat gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' na jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx tattat.

Na pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr gu Jakob ka't kia'mi'ñ gu Ejipto tattat tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhañ gu Moisees gu Aaroon guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tattat gu Ejipto jix duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ dhi' pai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu novɨ gu Siisara guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Asor gu novɨ gu Pilisteos gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab jix duu bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Baales gu Astarot; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jano' gu novɨ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhañ gu Jerobaal gu Bedaan gu Jeptee gu Samueel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu novɨ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios xikoolh guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' dhaibu buupui gu Naas gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan no'ch; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ñi'ook cham ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat boopoya' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' tu' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ja'p bhaan tattat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jano' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan gu vupui.

Jano' ba' cham jano' oraa' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' duuñ gu Jawatan Dios maa'n guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu suudai'; na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix gɨ' tu' na cham jir bhai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu Samueel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu suudai' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios gu Samueel.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Samueel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham vaak jodai; na gu' bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ uañi'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dhi' cham bhai' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' na ba' no'ch.

Jano' ba' gu Samueel jix aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx dhi' cham bhai'; gu' bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.

Na gu' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Na gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix duu gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu jiim gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' va'k tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt jix bhai' jix duu.

Na gu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu'r bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu'x tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Gu' gu' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham bhai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu Sauul guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam oidha' tas; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ka't gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu Israeel; gio ba' gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx gu Sauul gu Mikmas gu kavɨk gu Bet-el mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx gu Jonataan gu Gabaa gu Benjamiin; mi' dhɨr bhañ bɨx gu ja'tkam maa'n vaak zel.

Jano' ba' gu Jonataan naaka'n guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Pilisteos ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Pilisteos; gio ba' jix duu gu Sauul kuichdha' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu oidha' bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ebreos.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel jix kai chɨtda; gio ba' gu Sauul tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr gio gu Israeel guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa cham bhai' gu Pilisteos; jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Sauul gu Gilgal.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Pilisteos jum daa'ñ na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam na ja'p oo' jugii'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' gu Mikmas tas buusñi gu Bet-aben.

Na gu' gu' gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na gu' gu ja'tkam ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' dhɨt gu ebreos guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jordaan gu oidha' gu Gad gu Galaad; gio ba' gu Sauul ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Gilgal bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu kɨɨv gu tanoolh jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Samueel ka't tu ñi'ook; gu' gu Samueel cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Gilgal gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; mi' dhɨr makgɨrxi maa'nkar tai bhaan.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Samueel guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' gu Sauul jix buus guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na ba' tulhiiñdha'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Sauul jix aa'; na gu' tu' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu tanoolh gu Pilisteos mi'p tɨtda:―Aañ gu Mikmas.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jano' bhaan tu' gu Gilgal tu' cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; na gu' jano' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Gu' gu' jano' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' cham ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu chio'ñ bhaan gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan gu ja'tkam na gu' tu' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu Samueel jix tɨ'ɨ gu Gilgal gu Gabaa gu Benjamiin; gio ba' gu Sauul guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx na ja'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul gu Jonataan gu mar gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Gabaa gu Benjamiin; gu' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam yooxi' gu Mikmas.

Jano' ba' moor yooxi' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt gu Opra bhaan gu oidha' gu Sual.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan gu Bet-oron vaik guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Seboim bhaan oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu oidha' gu Israeel cham gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; na gu' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu ñi'ook; na ba' gu ebreos cham xoi'kam gu kuchii u'u kavɨk.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham gu ñi'ook gu kuchii tu' u'u kavɨk gu novɨ oi'ñdha' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx gu Sauul bɨɨx gu Jonataan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Sauul gu Jonataan gu mar ko'kmarak.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Pilisteos jix buus guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Mikmas.

Ba' jix aa' gu tanoolh ka't gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Pilisteos mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr cham jix duu maachim gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul ka't gu oidha' gu Gabaa bɨtaa'n guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga cham tu'x jai'ch gu Migroon gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx ka't na ja'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu Akîas gu mar gu Akîtob xibhɨk gu Ikâbod gu mar gu Pinees gu mar gu Eli jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Silo guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' cham bhai'x gu ja'tkam gu Jonataan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' gu Jonataan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Pilisteos ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim baasɨ'n; gio ba' maa'n guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Boses gu Sene.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bhaan gu Mikmas saagi'ñ bhaan gu Gabaa.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm no'ch; na cham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jɨɨ'ñdhidha'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ñi'ook jix aa'; gio ba' gu vupui bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' dhi' bɨndak aagak.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm no'ch guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' dhi' chulhiiñdha' pai' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Gu' gu' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ no'ch; na gu' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu noobh; jano' ba' dhi' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm nɨi'ñchudat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Pilisteos gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ebreos gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu ñi'ook gu Jonataan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ñi'ook gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ no'ch chulhiiñchuda' maachim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Jonataan jix aa' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' tu jiim bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' gu novɨ gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jonataan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx gu noobh tɨɨt bhaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan gu Jonataan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' dhi' ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jonataan bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ja'p guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ɨraab guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vaak ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm yooxi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gio guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Sauul guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dɨr gu Gabaa gu Benjamiin gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn baasɨ'n ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul gu ja'tkam ga'ra' baidhak; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios chɨkka ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat a'lhiok gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jonataan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul gu Akîas; gio ba' jix duu kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jano' ba' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' ka't kua' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn a'gi'ñchu' gu Sauul bɨɨx jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't yooxi' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' jano' ba' jix aa' gu Sauul jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Sauul bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx ka'm pai' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu kuchii maa'n ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan duiñchu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't jix gɨ'.

Jano' ba' gu ebreos guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dhi' bɨɨx gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios va'k guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨbiap bɨɨx xikoolh yooxi' gio suulhgia' suulh na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx gu Israelitas mi'p bɨɨx gu Sauul bɨɨx gu Jonataan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx gu Israelitas guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu kavɨk gu Epraim tɨiñ gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gio guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-aben.

Gu' gu' gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; na gu' gu Sauul ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam bham; mi' dhɨr gu Kualkuiera guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai bɨɨx ka'm ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam cham ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim pai' ka't suudai' na jix bhai' gu vupui yooxi'.

Jano' ba' chɨbiapui gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm suudai' na jix bhai' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu novɨ gu chin; na gu' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Na pai' dhuuk cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jonataan cham ka't naak na pai' dhuuk gu taat guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu novɨ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ suudai' na jix bhai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu novɨ gu chin; gio ba' gu vupui jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' maa'n gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' gu taat tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ka't gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; jano' ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan; gio ba' gu taat tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jano' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vupui guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn dhi' suudai' na jix bhai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jano' jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jix duu mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Pilisteos dɨr gu Mikmas bɨɨx ka'm gu Ajaloon; gu' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix jai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kakneer guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ali' vaakax guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu oidha' gu ja'tkam jix jugi bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn aa'ñdham gu Sauul gui'p; gio ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jano' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix gɨ' gu jodai.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam ja'xñi guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ maa'n guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kaneer guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Sauul jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't maa'n pai'x gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu tukaa' bhaan gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr gui'p; jano' ba' gu vupui xoi'kam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' jix aa' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan gu Pilisteos kapbhai' gu novɨ gu Israeel gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix maa guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chɨkka tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dhi' uañi'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios dodhia' gu Israeel tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu mar gu Jonataan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tɨɨda'; gio ba' cham ka't bɨx gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dhi' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' gu Jonataan gu mar dhi' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam jix aa' gu Sauul; jano' ba' gu vupui xoi'kam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' jix maa guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jonataan gu Sauul gu ja'tkam jix buus namkidhat.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu Jonataan gu mar; mi' dhɨr ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jonataan.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul gu Jonataan; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; mi' dhɨr gu Jonataan jix duu jix aa'; jano' ba' tɨɨda' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu novɨ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn suudai' na jix bhai'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm koi.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga koi gu Jonataan.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu ja'tkam gu Sauul; gio ba' tu' koi gu Jonataan tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi' tulhiiñdha' jix gɨ' gu Israeel cham ka't; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mo'o gu oidha' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ja'tkam gu Jonataan na ba' cham vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu Pilisteos jix bɨɨx duu pai'.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Sauul oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios xikoolh; gio ba' bhaan gu Moab bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon bhaan gu Edom bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba bhaan gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham tu' naaka'n gu Amalek guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Israeel gu novɨ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sauul jix bɨɨx duu gu Jonataan gu Isui gu Melki-sua; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' jix gɨ' gu Merab jix ali' gu Mikâl.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu u'vɨ gu Sauul ka't gu Ainoam mar u'vɨ gu Aimaas; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't gu Abner gu mar gu Ner guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Sauul.
Na gu' na gu' gu Kis gu taat gu Sauul gu Ner gu taat gu Abner jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Abiel.

Jano' ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't jix kavɨk bhaan gu Pilisteos bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Sauul; gio ba' no'x gu Sauul guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu chio'ñ jix kavɨk gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ baidhak.
