Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhañ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix duu gu Amalek gu Israeel; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu bhóogɨt na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Amalek guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx palhɨɨp; gio ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ a'aalh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kakneer jix ai buur.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jum daa'ñ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Telaim guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx gɨ' tɨɨt mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' bai'ñpu' gu Sauul kiicham gu Amalek jix dhaas guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul gu Kineo; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Amalek na ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨma'n bɨɨx; na pai' dhuuk tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Ejipto; jano' ba' jix ai'chdhix gu Kineo tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Amalek.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul naaka'n gu Amalek dɨr gu abila bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Sur guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Agag gu gɨ'kora' gu Amalek gu' bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu kuchii.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Agag tutkɨ kakneer gu vaakax jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu chuukug bɨx jix bhai'; na cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham tu' duu; gu' bɨx ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Samueel bham.

Na gu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' gu Sauul na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' cham tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Samueel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Samueel na ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Sauul guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xibh; gio ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Samueel bham; mi' dhɨr gu Sauul tu' tɨbiap gu Karmel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Gilgal.

Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel jano' ba'; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaakax dhi' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx maatɨt.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix aa'; gio ba' gu Amalek guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; na gu' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tutkɨ kakneer guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook dhi' gu tukaa'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' jix ali' gu vupui cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam mo'o bopxi'ñ gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios tu' Xoi'kam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' tu' bhañ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios u'ua'tulhdhix gu Amalek guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham naak gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix aa' gu Samueel; gio ba' va'k naak gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios bhañ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Agag gu gɨ'kora' gu Amalek guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Amalekitas.

Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios kakneer guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Gilgal.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel; gio ba' juraa'n gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ja'p guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tutkɨ makgɨrxi'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu chuukug.

Na gu' na gu' na ja'p uañi'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios uañi'ñ na ja'p duiñxim tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gio tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul gu Samueel; gio ba' tu' uañi'ñ; na guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; na gu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jano' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Samueel jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨndak; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gɨɨsɨk gu Samueel na ba' jix duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tu' jix maa tɨtmo tutkɨ tu'.
Jano' ba' gio gu Benkedor gu Israeel cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; na gu' cham gu chio'ñ na ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' uañi'ñ; gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan daraa gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Israeel; jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Samueel bhaan gu Sauul guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Sauul gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu Samueel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Agag gu gɨ'kora' gu Amalek; mi' dhɨr gu Agag suudai' u'va guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; jano' ba' jix aa' gu Agag; gio ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga koi'm.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel; gio ba' na ja'p gu kuchii guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu u'vɨ cham gu ma'nkam gu naan ka't cham gu mar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Samueel guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bapaalh gu Agag vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Gilgal.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Samueel gu Rama gu Sauul jix tɨ'ɨ gu vaak gu Gabaa gu Sauul.

Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr jix ñi' gu Samueel gu Sauul bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Samueel guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Sauul; gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Sauul guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Samueel; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk tu' jix xuaak gu Sauul guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' cham gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel gu inke guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Isaii gu Bet-leem; na gu' gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duu tu' gu Sauul guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨndak ali' vaakax guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu'; gio ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tɨbiap.
Jano' ba' mɨmɨim gu Isaii gu maa'nkar tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jix duu gu Samueel na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Bet-leem daraa kiicham moor guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx ɨɨbhi'ñ gui'p; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios namkia'.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu maa'nkar; jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Isaii gu ma'nkam jup tɨɨt gu maa'nkar.
Ba' jix aa' ka't na ja'p tɨɨtɨs jix ñi' gu Eliab; gio ba' tɨɨda' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios Xoi'kam.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Samueel; na gu' cham tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' jix gɨ' dhi' na gu' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam cham gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; na gu' gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam vupui bhaan gu vupui gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu i'ii'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Isaii gu Abinadab tu' jix duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vupui bhaan gu Samueel; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Isaii gu Samma; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Isaii kɨɨv gu ma'nkam vupui bhaan gu Samueel; gu' gu Samueel jix aa' gu Isaii; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn suulhgia'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel gu Isaii; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix ali' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn kakneer; jano' ba' jix aa' gu Samueel gu Isaii; na gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na gu' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa meesa bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' bhañ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; jano' ba' bamii' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' gu Samueel jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; gio ba' dɨr mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr jix búup gu Samueel guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Rama.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix ai'chdhix gu Sauul guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Sauul gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jano' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan tu duukam vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn oi'ñdha' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim kuichdha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; na pai' dhuuk na ba' na pai' dhuuk ua'tulhi'ñ bhaan tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix aa' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jano' oi'ñdha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ xoi'kam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' maa'n guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix aa' bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' buupui gu mar gu Isaii gu Bet-leem guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuichdha' jix kavɨk guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul bhañ jix duu gu Isaii bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Dabii gu mar bɨɨx kakneer.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Isaii buur gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va chiiw bhañ gu Sauul guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Dabii gu mar.
Jano' ba' bai'ñpu' gu Dabii gu Sauul juruuñ vupui bhaan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix jai' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam kutun kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul bhañ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Isaii; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; na gu' tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu Sauul gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu novɨ; gio ba' gu Sauul ga'ra' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't tutkɨ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos jum daa'ñ chugi'ñ na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Sokô gu Judaa guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sokô gu Aseka gu Epes-dammim.

Jano' ba' gio gu Sauul gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel jum daa'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Alkornokue guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos mi'p bhaan gu kavɨk baasɨ'n tu' gu Israeel ka't bhaan gu kavɨk baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix buus jano' ba' gu chio'ñ yooxi' gu Pilisteos jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook vaak ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Goliat gu Gat ga'ra' tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam mo'o tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tɨi'chu' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jixchamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' bhaan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix kavɨk jodai kutun kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat u'u kavɨk ka't na ja'p guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ga'ra' jix kavɨk jodai u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix kavɨk jodai; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn kutun kavɨk vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' tu jiim jix maa jiiñak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Israeel tu ñi'ook; gio ba' na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' gu Pilisteo guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu duukam gu Sauul gu Eskoged tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam chɨɨ' no'ch duduaka' tu duukam; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ chɨɨ' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat boopoya' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Pilisteo; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam yooxi' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Sauul bɨx gu Israeel dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Pilisteo guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ chooto'n ɨɨbhi'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't gu mar mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Eprateo gu Bet-leem gu Judaa gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Isaii ga'ra' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ma'nkam; gio ba' ka't dhi' gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Sauul guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' vaik gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Isaii guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Sauul bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ vaik gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Eliab maa'nkam mar gook gu Abinadab vaik gu Samma.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't jix ali'; gio ba' bhiadat vaik guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Sauul.
Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx gu Sauul na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam kakneer gu taat gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn mii' dhɨr gu Pilisteo guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xibh gu xumai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oo'm gu tanoolh.

Ba' jix aa' gu Isaii gu Dabii gu mar; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jano' na ba' gu ja'tkam gu Epa dhi' kai'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam dhi' ja'tkam mambhɨɨx gu takarui' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jootom vaak ja'tkam gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam dhi' ja'tkam mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bii'm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul bɨx gu Israeel mi'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Alkornokue guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii gu xibh guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn kakneer guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix nukadham ka't bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Isaii ka't jix duu; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu jiim ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jir bɨx bhai' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Na gu' na gu' gu Israelitas na ja'p gu Pilisteos mi'p jir bɨx bhai' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhaan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhaan gu ñi'ook gu novɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dai'bus guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' tu jiim ka't tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam tu' mi'p guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' kua' a'gi'ñchu' bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook vaak ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Goliat gu Pilisteo gu Gat jix buus guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix kai gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Israeel tu jiim mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ko'kmarak choo'n.

Jano' ba' maa'n gu Israeel chɨtda; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ buupui mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr chɨɨ' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx namkɨm maa'n mar u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu vaak gu taat gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii ju'ñdharan mi'p bham; na gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix duu gu chio'ñ chɨɨ' dhi' gu Pilisteo guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Israeel na gu' chɨkka dhi' gu Pilisteo guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix aa' gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu chio'ñ chɨɨ'.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ñiokda' gu Eliab xibhɨk jix gɨ' bɨɨx mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu Eliab guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan gu Dabii; gio ba' na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ chɨkka tɨtda:―Cha'pim mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ kakneer oidha' jix gaki tu' kakasnira' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu i'ii'ñ na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨbiap.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' jano' dhi' cham gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam na ja'p maa'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Dabii ka't tu ñi'ook na ja'p guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vupui bhaan gu Sauul guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Sauul; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ kuiñcha; mi' dhɨr tu duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx dhi' gu Pilisteo.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul gu Dabii; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' bhaan mii' dhɨr gu Pilisteo na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx; na gu' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham dɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' tu duukam ka't bipia'dam kakneer gu taat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn maavɨt guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mar kaneer guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' busaak tu' bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu chin; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan tu' jootos gu novɨ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jum duu maavɨt jum duu guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; na gu' dhi' gu Pilisteo guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ka't na ja'p maa'n na gu' tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maavɨt guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gio guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu novɨ dhi' gu Pilisteo; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Sauul gu Dabii; jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Dabii guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix dhaas bhaan mo'o guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Na gu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Dabii gu kuchii bhaan jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na gu' cham pai' dhuuk ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Sauul; na gu' tu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx dhi' na gu' cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Dabii mii' dhɨr tu'x.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jixchamaam gu jodai guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix dhaas guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan gu Pilisteo.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteo guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Dabii kutun kavɨk vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Pilisteo tu jiim jix ñi' gu Dabii guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; na gu' ka't biapma' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Pilisteo gu Dabii; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' gagai' na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' bɨɨx kaapak guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Pilisteo gu Dabii; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu chuukug gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vaakax yooxi'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Pilisteo; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' bɨɨx gu kuchii u'u kavɨk kutun kavɨk; gu' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Israeel tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' kapbhai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu novɨ tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mo'o tu'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu chuukug gu Pilisteos gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vaakax gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu oidha' bɨx cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx dhi' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios cham dodhia' bɨɨx gu kuchii u'u kavɨk; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨ'ñdham kapbhai' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu noobh.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu Pilisteo jix búup na ba' tu' jix duu bhaan gu Dabii jix maa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dai'bus guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan gu Pilisteo.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Dabii gu novɨ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jix bhɨɨ gu jodai guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' naaka'n gu Pilisteo guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' gu jodai guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha' bhaan gu vupui.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Dabii gu Pilisteo bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu jodai; gio ba' tu' naaka'n gu Pilisteo guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ cham mambhɨɨx gu Dabii gu kuchii gu novɨ.

Gu' gu' dai'bus gu Dabii jix dhaas bhaan gu Pilisteo dhaagɨk gu kuchii guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx mo'o; gio ba' na ja'p gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix koi jiboi'ññor.

Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu Israeel gu Judaa jix maa guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhiadat gu Pilisteos bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx ka'm kiki'ñgob gu Ekroon; gio ba' ia'rɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt gu Saraim bɨɨx ka'm gu Gat gu Ekroon.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix bhɨɨ mo'o gu Pilisteo guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jerusalem gu' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook vaak zel.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk gu Sauul jix ñi' gu Dabii busaak jix ai bɨɨx gu Pilisteo gu Abner guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Abner chɨkka gu mar mii' dhɨr biapma' gu Abner jix aa'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' cham tu'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook chɨkka gu mar mii' dhɨr biapma'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ kooda' gu Pilisteo gu Abner jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vupui bhaan gu Sauul ua'tulhdhidha' mo'o gu Pilisteo gu novɨ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' biapma' chɨkka jix duu gu mar gu Dabii jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu mar tu duukam gu Isaii gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook ñiokda' bɨɨx gu Sauul gu i'ii'ñ gu Jonataan ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jonataan na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix bhɨɨ mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaak gu taat.
Na gu' jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jonataan gu Dabii na gu' dha'da' na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jonataan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ga'ra' bhaan jix maa gu Dabii guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx ka'm gu kuchii u'u gat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' busaak gu Dabii pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Sauul guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Sauul guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu vupui bɨx gu ja'tkam gu vupui guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Sauul.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kooda' gu Pilisteo moor gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu gɨ'kora' gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' alabaa'n gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu Sauul naaka'n guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Dabii mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Ba' jix aa' bhaam gu Sauul guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ dhi' gu ñi'ook gu vupui; gio ba' gu Dabii jix maa mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' dɨr mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Sauul tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ gu Sauul guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vaak bɨɨx bhaan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; gio ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu novɨ na ja'p gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr ka't u'u kavɨk gu novɨ gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Sauul u'u kavɨk bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; mi' dhɨr gook mui'kim jix ai'chdhix gu Dabii.
Na gu' gu' gu Sauul guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Dabii na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix ai'chdhix gu Sauul tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ'; gio ba' busaak guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Sauul guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Na gu' gu' bɨx gu Israeel gu Judaa dha'da' gu Dabii na gu' busaak guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul gu Dabii; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Merab mar u'vɨ jix gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu chio'ñ jix kavɨk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios; gu' gu Sauul chɨtda; gio ba' cham ka't gu novɨ bhaan gu' gu novɨ gu Pilisteos ka't bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu oidha' ja'tkam vaak gu taat gu Israeel na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' tɨbiap guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Merab mar u'vɨ gu Sauul ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ gu Adriel gu Meolatita.
Gu' gu' gu Mikâl mar u'vɨ gu Sauul dha'da' gu Dabii; gio ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Sauul guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vupui.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ba' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix duu na ba' gu novɨ gu Pilisteos ka't bhaan; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Sauul gu Dabii; jano' ba' bɨɨx ka' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Sauul guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' tu ñi'ook ɨxchuixim gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim xoi'kam; jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Sauul tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook maatɨt gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Dabii jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' gu chio'ñ gampai' matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Sauul jix maa guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Dabii.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' ja'xñi gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' jix duu guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Pilisteos na ba' ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora'; gu' gu Sauul guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Dabii gu noobh gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix duu gu Dabii dhi' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vupui gu Dabii na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ cham ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii ta'tak bɨɨx gu ja'tkam tu' naaka'n guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu chichio'ñ gu Pilisteos; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn kapbhai' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' na ba' jum duu guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu Sauul jix maa mar u'vɨ gu Mikâl guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ.
Gu' gu' gu Sauul ñɨi'ñ jix duu gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx gu Dabii mar u'vɨ gu Mikâl dha'da'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Dabii; gio ba' ka't gu Sauul bhaamki'ñdha' gu Dabii bɨx gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam chiñia' gu Pilisteos; gio ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx tu duukam gu Sauul; mi' dhɨr ka't gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul gu Jonataan gu mar bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Dabii; gu' gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul dha'da' gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' jix maa aa'ñdham gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu Sauul gu taat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa kooda'; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jano' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ dhi' ju'ñdharan gu taat yooxi' pai' jix duu; gio ba' tu ñi'ook tu' gu taat tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ maachim guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan xoi'kam gu Dabii gu Sauul gu taat; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' bhaan tu duukam gu Dabii matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr va'k buimɨi tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' jix dhaas gu i'ii'ñ gu novɨ tu' naaka'n gu Pilisteo gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha' bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhaan gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Dabii cham kuiñcha.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Sauul gu ñi'ook gu Jonataan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jano' ba' gu Jonataan gu Dabii jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Dabii gu Sauul juruuñ vupui bhaan na ja'p va'k.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' jix buus gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Pilisteos tu' naaka'n bɨɨx jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu Sauul; gio ba' kua' daakat gu vaak ga'ra' u'u kavɨk gu novɨ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Dabii bɨɨx u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gu' jix ai'chdhix vupui bhaan gu Sauul naaka'n bɨɨx u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; mi' dhɨr gu Dabii guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul bhañ jix duu gu vaak gu Dabii na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu xibh; gu' gu Mikâl gu u'vɨ jix ñi'ñ gu Dabii bham; mi' dhɨr tu' cham dodhia' gu oidha' dhi' gu tukaa' gu xibh ka' jix koi.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Mikâl gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Mikâl dhi' jix dhaas bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios chiiw jix bhaan dhaas bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Sauul bhañ jix duu guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Dabii jix aa'; gio ba' ka'ook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Sauul tɨip jix duu na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Dabii bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix duu baap guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios chiiw guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul gu Mikâl; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tɨtda:―Cha'pim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaamki'ñdha' gu Mikâl jix aa' gu Sauul; na gu' jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu'; gio ba' tu' cham tu' kooda'.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam suudai' u'va gu Samueel gu Rama bɨx gu Sauul ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Samueel guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Najot.
Jano' ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Sauul bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Dabii gu Najot gu Rama.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu Sauul jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn chu'p jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Samueel ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jix duu gu Sauul gio guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ka't maachim gu Sauul bhañ jix duu gio guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' gu Sauul guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tɨip guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu jiim jix duu gio guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Rama; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam oidha' suudai' jix gɨ' gu Sokô tɨtda:―¿Jax bham; mi' dhɨr duukat gu Samueel gu Dabii ka't tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Najot gu Rama.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Najot gu Rama; gio ba' gio suudai' u'va bhaan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Najot gu Rama.

Jano' ba' gio guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vupui bhaan gu Samueel guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tɨbiaptuda bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gio gu Sauul tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Najot gu Rama suudai' u'va vupui bhaan gu Jonataan; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' na cham jir bhai' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam uañi'ñ bhaan gu taat tu jiim gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' matgɨm; mi' dhɨr cham koi; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu taat matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix gɨ' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu taat dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham ka't.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ñi'ook kavɨk aa' bham; gio ba' gu taat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan gu vupui guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; na gu' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dhi' gu Jonataan na gu' cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix duu; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' koi'm.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan gu Dabii; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu'.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu Jonataan; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xibh ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu masad tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' jugi; gu' tu' kiicha' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai vaik gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' tu' gu taat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' daipu'; na gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix jai' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' jootom gu Bet-leem kiicham na gu' bɨx gu ma'nkam namki' gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Bien bhai'x i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu duukam; gu' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix duu xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx tu duukam tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak; gio ba' tu' tu' na cham jir bhai' cham tu'x jai'ch tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx ka'm gu taat.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr va'k xoi'kam tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu taat na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan tu' cham ka't tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Jonataan; gio ba' chɨkka maa'n aa'ñdham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' gu taat tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan gu Dabii; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi'; mi' dhɨr moor guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ yooxi'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jonataan gu Dabii; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' tu ñi'ook gu taat gu xibh dhi' gu tas mi' dhɨr gu xibh guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat xoi'kam na ba' bɨɨx gu Dabii tu' jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jonataan dhi' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gu' tu' gu taat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ cham bhai' gio tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhai'x i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak na ja'p ka't bɨɨx gu taat.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Jawatan Dios; gu' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ jix koi.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu vaak; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios maa'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maa'n guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Dabii gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jonataan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jonataan ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu vaak gu Dabii bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Dabii.
Na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jonataan ñi'ook kavɨk aa' gu Dabii na gu' dha'da' na gu' dha'da' na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan; na gu' gu xibh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu masad tu' ka' baas guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' gu Estaraas vaik gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ɨlhdham pai' dhi' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tanoolh tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ju'ñdharan gu jodai gu Esel.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vaik guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ja'p guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix toja.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix duu tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; na gu' tu' ɨlhdham na gu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa cham tu' cham tu'x jai'ch cham bhai' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu'; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu ñi'ook ka't gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm yooxi' namkia' ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu masad jix daa gu gɨ'kora' jugi gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix daa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ja'p guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jonataan jix búup jix daa gu Abner guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Sauul pai' gu Dabii ka't cham tu'x jai'ch.

Ba' jix aa' gu' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Sauul cham cham tu' na gu' chɨtda; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham na jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak gook gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu masad ka't gio guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Dabii ka't cham tu'x jai'ch; gio ba' gu Sauul jix aa' gu Jonataan gu mar; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham tu' tɨbiap jugi gu mar gu Isaii guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jonataan jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-leem.

Ba' jix aa'; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' na gu' tañia' gu maa'nkar chulhiiñdha' gu ma'nkam kiicham xibhɨk tu' jix duu; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jano' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu ja'tkam; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' cham tu' tɨbiap meesa gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan gu Jonataan; gio ba' gu mar guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ cham tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu mar gu Isaii na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ xi'ɨraam gu naan.

Na gu' na gu' bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu mar gu Isaii guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan gu oidha' tu' ka' gu ñi'ook tu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; na gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jano' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na gu' tu' koi.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan gu taat gu Sauul; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Sauul guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix ko'k; gio ba' pai' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jonataan gu taat ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam kooda' gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Jonataan meesa bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham jix jugi gu takarui' gook gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu masad; na gu' ga'ra' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kuiñcha gu Dabii na gu' gu taat ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu xibh jix buus gu Jonataan yooxi' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix ali' bɨɨx.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr na ja'p guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jonataan ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jonataan jix maa jiiñak bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bham; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jonataan bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ cham tu' tu jiim; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jonataan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ suudai' u'va gu Jawatan.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jonataan gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Ba' jix aa' jix maa gu Jonataan gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios kiicham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix búup gu Dabii baasɨ'n saagi'ñ tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios vaik mui'kim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha'; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat maa'n guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim maa'n bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Dabii guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan gu Dabii; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhai'x i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ba' bɨɨx tas; jano' ba' jix búup ka't; gio ba' gu Jonataan chɨbiapui kiicham.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Dabii gu Nob gu Aimelek jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Aimelek guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ soo'mchulhdhak bɨndak.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Aimelek; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix aa'; mi' dhɨr soo'mchulhdhak guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' jootsa' tu' jix duu; jano' ba' tu' nɨi'ñchudat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tɨɨda' pai'.
Jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu novɨ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jixchamaam gu takarui' bakia'.

Ba' jix aa' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Dabii; gio ba' cham no'ñ gu takarui' kua'dam gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam no'ñ gu takarui' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu u'vɨ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; na pai' dhuuk tɨɨda' gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix bɨɨx duu jɨɨgi'ñdham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu takarui' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Na gu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix maa gu takarui' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na gu' cham ka't gu takarui' tɨkiix guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jaisaidhat gu takarui' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu tanoolh jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh ka't maa'n tu duukam gu Sauul guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Doeg gu Idumeo gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bipia'dam gu Sauul.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Aimelek; na gu' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu novɨ u'u kavɨk gu kuchii na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu novɨ gu kuchii tu' gu ñi'ook na gu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix aa'; gio ba' gu kuchii gu Goliat gu Pilisteo tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Alkornokue guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr tu' tu jiim jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr matgɨm na ja'p; jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu Dabii mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Sauul suudai' u'va gu Akîs gu gɨ'kora' gu Gat.

Jano' ba' tu duukam gu Akîs gui'p; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam alabaa'n guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bham; mi' dhɨr naaka'n gu Sauul guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Dabii mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix dhaas gu i'ii'ñ dhi' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim choo'n gu Akîs gu gɨ'kora' gu Gat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu noobh guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kiki'ñgob guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Akîs tu duukam; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñɨi'ñ gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vupui bhaan tu' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu Yeendose gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jumpa'n gu Adullam; gio ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ja'tkam bɨx gu vaak gu taat tɨɨtɨs.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨx ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim baidhak na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu chichio'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' ka't gu Dabii gu Mispa gu Moab gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ gu taat gu naan bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Dabii juruuñ gu kavɨk.

Ba' jix aa' gu Gad gu Dabii; gio ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' gu kavɨk guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu oidha' gu Judaa; mi' dhɨr gu Dabii ta'tak suudai' u'va guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu aret.

Jano' ba' jix kai gu Sauul na ja'p ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Dabii mi'p bɨɨx; gio ba' ka't jano' ba' gu Sauul gu Gabaa bɨtaa'n gu u'u gu Rama ga'ra' u'u kavɨk gu novɨ bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ mi'p guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ mi'p guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jano' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin; mi' dhɨr maa'n gio bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu mar gu Isaii guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨx bopxi'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Na bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan tu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios naak na ja'p gu mar tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu mar gu Isaii tu' oi'ñdha' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ja'p gu mar tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam bhaan tu' na ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Doeg gu Idumeo ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu duukam gu Sauul; gio ba' tu' gu mar gu Isaii suudai' u'va gu Nob gu Aimelek gu mar gu Aitob.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios jix maa guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gio jix maa gu kuchii gu Goliat gu Pilisteo.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' bhañ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Aimelek gu mar gu Aitob guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu vaak gu taat jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan mi'p gu Nob; gio ba' bɨx tɨɨtɨs gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jano' gu mar gu Aitob; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan tu' gu mar gu Isaii na pai' dhuuk tu' chɨɨdak gu takarui' gu kuchii guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ja'p guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu tanoolh.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Aimelek gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' chɨkka tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx tu duukam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ja'p gu Dabii guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu gɨ'kora' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak.

Jano' ba' kua'da' tu' dɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't tu'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu duukam tu' bɨx gu vaak gu taat; na gu' tu duukam matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix gɨ' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga koi gu Aimelek tu' bɨx gu vaak gu taat.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't xikoolh; gio ba' mia'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gio gu novɨ bɨɨx gu Dabii pu'ñir guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gu' tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix duu gu noobh na ba' kooda' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Doeg; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Doeg gu Idumeo guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jixchamaam gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu Nob kiicham jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix dhaas guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu u'vɨ a'aalh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vaakax buur kakneer bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Gu' gu' maa'n gu ma'nkam gu Aimelek gu mar gu Aitob guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Abiatar guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu Abiatar guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Dabii na ja'p gu Sauul ka't jix koi jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Abiatar; gio ba' tu' bhai'x kua' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Doeg gu Idumeo ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maachim gu Sauul; mi' dhɨr tu' jix maa bua' bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak gu taat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam cham jum i'obh; na guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gio guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam tu' dhi' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' jix maa aa'ñdham gu Dabii bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Keila guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix duu.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' jix duu dhi' ja'tkam gu Pilisteos gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Keila.

Gu' gu' mi'p bɨɨx gu Dabii gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm no'ch gu Judaa dhi' bɨɨx ɨɨbhi'ñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Keila bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr bamii' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Keila tu' kapbhai' gu noobh gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' ta'tak gu Dabii bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Keila guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' naaka'n bɨɨx jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Dabii gu Keila.
Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Abiatar gu mar gu Aimelek gu Dabii gu Keila suudai' u'va gio bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Sauul gu Dabii ka't tɨbiap gu Keila; gio ba' jano' ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu noobh; na gu' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kiicham bɨɨx kiki'ñgob guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Sauul bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Keila guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Dabii guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Dabii gu Sauul guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ cham bhai' bhaan gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu duukam juraa'n guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Sauul guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan gu Keila cham tu' duu kiicham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuiñcha guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' kapbhai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Keila gu noobh guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Sauul na ja'p tu duukam juraa'n naak gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix duu tu duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' kapbhai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Keila tu' gu chichio'ñ gu noobh gu Sauul gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Te kapbhai'.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii jano' ba' jix búup bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ja'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm moor gu Keila jix bɨɨx duu baasɨ'n; gio ba' suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Sauul na ja'p gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Keila; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't oidha' jix gaki guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu kavɨk oidha' jix gaki gu Sip; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Sauul bɨx gu tanoolh gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham do'ñcho gu noobh.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Dabii gu Sauul ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim oidha' jix gaki gu Sip.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul suudai' u'va gu Dabii guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham jum i'obh cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu Sauul gu taat tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu Israeel tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gook mi' dhɨr tu'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Sauul gu taat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' ba'k jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jonataan guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Sip guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Sauul gu Gabaa; gio ba' cham gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu akîla gu novɨ jix duu oidha' jix gaki.
Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jano' jootom bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ no'ch kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix duu tu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jano' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat pai' juraa'n tɨɨt chɨkka ka't buupui; na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook jix maat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat pai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' bɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' jix duu bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; na tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu oidha' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx jix duu gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix búup jix bɨɨx duu gu Sip vupui bhaan gu Sauul; gu' gu Dabii gu ja'tkam mi'p oidha' jix gaki gu Maoon guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ kɨɨ'n oidha' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' ta'tak gu Sauul bɨɨx gu ja'tkam tu jiim; gu' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Dabii jix dhaav jodai kavɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn oidha' jix gaki gu Maoon; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Sauul jix kai chɨ'ɨɨk gu Dabii oidha' jix gaki gu Maoon.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu kavɨk gu Dabii bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu kavɨk; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Dabii na ba' tu' vupui bhaan gu Sauul; gu' gu Sauul guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu ja'tkam na ba' jix bhɨɨ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' suudai' u'va mattuda' gu Sauul bham; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na gu' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Sauul guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Dabii ta'tak bhaan gu Pilisteos; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' kuiñcha jix dhaas mii' dhɨr pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Sela-amma-lekot.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Sauul guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Dabii ta'tak bhaan gu Pilisteos; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' kuiñcha jix dhaas mii' dhɨr pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Sela-amma-lekot.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix tɨ'ɨ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix kavɨk gu Engaddi.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Sauul guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Pilisteos jix maa aa'ñdham bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Dabii oidha' jix gaki gu Engaddi.

Jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu Sauul vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨx gu Israeel ka't tu jiim gu Dabii guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ chiiw gu kakkavɨk.

Jano' ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam kakneer gu bhóogɨt pai' ka't jumpa'n chɨbiapui gu Sauul guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tɨɨt; gio ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ mi'p guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jumpa'n.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tanoolh tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kapbhai' bhaamki'ñdha' gu noobh jix duu bɨɨx na ja'p tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jugii'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Sauul.
Na gu' mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na gu' ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jugii'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Sauul.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bhaan gu Jawatan Xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu novɨ bhaan; na gu' Xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios.

Na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Dabii guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu Sauul; gio ba' gu Sauul gamai' jumpa'n ka't gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' gio gu Dabii jix búup mi' dhɨr gamai' jumpa'n jix maa jiiñak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Sauul bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' na ja'p gu Sauul tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Dabii guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu vupui gu oidha' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Sauul; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Dabii guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa cham bhai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ buupui guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vupui na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu noobh jumpa'n; na gu' gui'p tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na gu' tu ñi'ook; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ bhaan gu Jawatan na gu' Xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu taat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jugii'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jugii'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios cham tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch cham bhai' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu novɨ tu' uañi'ñ bhaan tu'; jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha' na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' gu Jawatan Dios; gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu novɨ cham ka't bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; na ba' gu novɨ cham ka't bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' bhaan chɨkka tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel chɨkka o'bhagi'ñchu' gagai' jix koi guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jir bɨx bhai' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat kuiñcha guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu novɨ.

Ba' jix aa' ka't na ja'p gu Dabii jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Sauul; gio ba' cham dhi' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Sauul gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jir bhai' jix duu tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx xoi'kam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx cham bhai'.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam xoi'kam; na gu' cham jix koi guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu noobh.

Na gu' na gu' chɨkka gu ñi'ook bhaamki'ñdha' kiicha' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨɨx xoi'kam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' gu tanoolh guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' jano' na ja'p tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu novɨ gu ñi'ook dhi'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jano' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu vaak gu taat; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Sauul; mi' dhɨr ka't gu Sauul gu vaak gu Dabii guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Samueel jum daa'ñ bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak gu Rama; gio ba' jix búup gu Dabii ka't oidha' jix gaki gu Paraan.

Jano' ba' gu Maoon ka't gu chio'ñ ga'ra' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Karmelo ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ga'ra' vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' kakneer mambhɨɨx gɨ' chiiw; gio ba' ka't bakia' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kakneer gu Karmelo.

Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ ka't gu Nabal gu tɨɨgɨ' gu u'vɨ gu Abigail; gio ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix bhai' nɨidhidha'; gu' gu chio'ñ ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tomaat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; jano' ba' ka't gu ma'nkam gu Kaleb.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Dabii oidha' jix gaki gu Nabal guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kakneer.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' bhañ gu Dabii mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Karmelo tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Nabal ñio'kdha' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' ja'xñi; na guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ ja'tkam vaak bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' jano' bipia'dam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dhi' bɨɨx no'ch cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu kavɨk tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dhi' gu Karmelo.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ nɨidhidha' gu vupui guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix duu gu novɨ tu duukam gu mar gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Dabii gui'p gu Nabal guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Nabal guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Dabii; gio ba' chɨkka gu Dabii chɨkka gu mar gu Isaii gu Mukos tu duukam cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' jano' gu takarui' gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu chichio'ñ cham tu' duukat.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Dabii suulh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt tɨɨtɨs gui'p gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga maa'n gu kuchii; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maa'n gu kuchii; jano' ba' gio gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu kuchii; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan gu Dabii na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' maa'n guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix maa aa'ñdham gu Abigail gu u'vɨ gu Nabal bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Dabii bhañ jix duu oidha' jix gaki tulhiiñdha' chulhiiñdha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Gu' gu' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu kavɨk tu' matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dhi' yooxi'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaak jodai gu tanoolh gu tukaa' bɨx gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dhi' bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam kakneer.

Na gu' jano' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na gu' cham bhai' bɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan chulhiiñdha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan bɨx gu vaak; na gu' gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios cham bhai' cham cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ñiokda'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Abigail jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu takarui' gook o'jo' suudai' u'va jixchamaam kakneer guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jixchamaam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios kai'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu takarui' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat buur.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr cham tu' jix duu gu chio'ñ gu Nabal.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhaan buur jix dhaav guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Dabii guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ aajidha' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duu guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam juraa'n oidha' jix gaki cham cham tu' ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham bhai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Dabii gu xibh cham no'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨx ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
