Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Abigail jix ñi' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa buur guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan gu Dabii bhaan gu vupui guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨɨt; gio ba' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan tu' ka't uañi'ñ; gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu ñi'ook ja'tkam na tu juan maatɨt guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook ja'tkam na tu juan.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jano' gu Jawatan gu i'ii'ñ mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Nabal; na gu' jurtu'nka' gu tɨɨgɨ'; mi' dhɨr mɨmɨim gu Nabal guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx; gu' tu' ja'tkam na tu juan cham tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhi' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu novɨ; gio ba' ka't na ja'p gu Nabal guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham bhai' bhaan gu Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jano' dhi' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ja'tkam na tu juan tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan.

Jano' ba' tu' soi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ja'tkam na tu juan dhi' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tɨɨda' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan na gu' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios cham bhai' cham tu' gaagam tu' gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' xoi'kam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu oidha' bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu vupui guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na ja'p tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu Jawatan jurtu'nka' bɨx xoi'kam tu' tu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham tu' ka't dhi' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu i'ii'ñ cham tu'x jai'ch vaak na jix bhaan gu ɨ'ɨr cham kuiñcha gu Jawatan ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam xoi'kam gu Jawatan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ja'tkam na tu juan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Abigail; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' bhañ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ cham bhai' tu' cham tu' jix duu jix maa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu xibh cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Nabal guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Dabii gu novɨ ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' tu jiim bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu vaak guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam naak gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu Abigail suudai' u'va gu Nabal guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ga'ra' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak na ja'p guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu Nabal ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham jix duu guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' jix jai' bɨɨx ka'm suudai' u'va gu tanoolh buimgidhak.

Na pai' dhuuk gu' gu xibh na pai' dhuuk suudai' u'va ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Nabal guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu'x; gio ba' xoi'kam gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ja'p gu jodai.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n gu Nabal jix koi.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix kai gu Nabal ka't jix koi; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa kuiñcha guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu novɨ gu Nabal tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios cham bhai' tu duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Nabal bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mo'o; jano' ba' mi' dhɨr bhañ gu Dabii ñiokda' gu Abigail na ba' jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Dabii tɨɨtɨs gu Abigail gu Karmelo tu ñi'ook bɨɨx bham; gio ba' gu Dabii tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' jix búup tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu vupui gu oidha' bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ja'tkam na tu juan na ba' ka't ja'tkam na tu juan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tɨɨt tu duukam gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu Abigail bɨɨx jixchamaam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam oi'ñchu' gɨ' kavɨk buur chɨ'ɨɨk jix duu gu Dabii ka't gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gio jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii gu Ainoam gu Jesreel guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook jix bɨɨx duu gu u'vɨ.
Na gu' na gu' gu Sauul ka't jix maa mar u'vɨ gu Mikâl gu u'vɨ gu Dabii gu Palti gu mar gu Lais ka't gu Gallim.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Sipeos gu Sauul gu Gabaa bham; gio ba' cham gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu akîla vupui bhaan oidha' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul jano' ba' jix búup jix dhaav oidha' jix gaki gu Sip guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ baidhak vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Israeel na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Dabii oidha' jix gaki gu Sip.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Sauul yooxi' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu akîla vupui bhaan oidha' jix gaki ju'ñdharan gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' ka't gu Dabii oidha' jix gaki guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Sauul guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios pai' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhañ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨɨda' gu Sauul ka't tɨbiap.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ pai' gu Sauul ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ yooxi'; gio ba' tu jiim gu Dabii pai' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Sauul gu Abner gu mar gu Ner guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; mi' dhɨr ka't gu Sauul kookos guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm yooxi' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Aimelek gu eteo gu Abisai gu mar gu Sarbia xibhɨk gu Joab bham; gio ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Sauul yooxi' jix aa' gu Abisai; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨndak.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Abisai tɨɨtɨs gu ja'tkam gu tukaa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Sauul ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kookos guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Abner gu ja'tkam mi'p xikoolh guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abisai gu Dabii; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' gu Jawatan Dios dhagia' bhaamki'ñdha' gu noobh; mi' dhɨr jano' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu Abisai; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; na gu' chɨkka jix duu gu novɨ bhaan Xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Dabii; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' cham jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu novɨ bhaan Xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios; gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jano' u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Dabii u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu suudai' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Sauul jix bɨɨx duu; na cham ka't soo'mchulhdhak guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; na gu' jix dhaam suudai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan.
Jano' ba' bhɨi gu Dabii baasɨ'n jix dhaas guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk dhaibu jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix maa jiiñak gu Dabii gu ja'tkam gu Abner gu mar gu Ner bham; gio ba' cham tu ñi'ook gu Abner jano' ba' gu Abner jix aa'; mi' dhɨr chɨkka jix duu tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jiiñak gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Abner; gio ba' cham jix duu gu chio'ñ tu' chɨkka cham tu'x jai'ch na ja'p tu' gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan tu' kia'mi'ñ maa'n gu ja'tkam kooda' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam cham xoi'kam; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam koi'm cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jano' duukat u'u kavɨk gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu suudai' ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Sauul gu ñi'ook gu Dabii; gio ba' cham dhi' gu ñi'ook gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan tu duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham bhai' cham tu'x jai'ch gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' soi'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jano' gu ñi'ook tu duukam; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu maa'nkar; gu' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ baas guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios bham; jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jano' gu ɨ'ɨr gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu kakkavɨk.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul; gio ba' uañi'ñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam cham bhai' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu oidha' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vupui; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm u'u kavɨk gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ maa'n guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa maa'n bɨx bhai' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; na gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't dhagia' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu novɨ gu' tu' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix duu gu novɨ bhaan Xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ja'p gu oidha' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vupui ka't gu oidha' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios namkidhat bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul gu Dabii; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix duu tu' gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't gu bhóogɨt gu Sauul guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ pai'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix koi guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Sauul; mi' dhɨr cham tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ka't tutkɨ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu oidha' gu Pilisteos na ba' gu Sauul guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu noobh.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chichio'ñ ga'ra' baidhak guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Akîs gu mar gu Maok gu gɨ'kora' gu Gat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii bɨɨx gu Akîs gu Gat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ maa'n bɨɨx ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Dabii bɨɨx gook gu u'vɨ gu Ainoam gu Jesreelita gu Abigail ka't gu u'vɨ gu Nabal gu Karmelo.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Sauul gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Gat cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Akîs; gio ba' tu' gaagam jano' nɨidhidha' gu vupui guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix maa pai' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jɨ'dɨlh gu oidha' pai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu duukam bɨndak kiicham vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Akîs jix maa mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Siklag; gio ba' ka't gu Siklag gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu tanoolh gu Dabii guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu oidha' gu Pilisteos maakobh masaa'n dhɨt gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Dabii bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ba'k gu Gesureos gu Gerseos gu Amalekitas; na gu' dhi' ja'tkam oi'ñka' tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' dɨr na ja'p tu' gu Sur bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu oidha' gu chio'ñ tu' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ kakneer guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam buur jix ai guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Akîs.

Jano' ba' chɨtda gu Akîs; gio ba' duukat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Dabii chɨtda; mi' dhɨr saagi'ñ gu Judaa saagi'ñ gu Jerameel bhaan saagi'ñ gu Keni.

Jano' ba' tu' gu chio'ñ tu' gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu oidha' gu Dabii guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Gat; gio ba' bham; na gu' cham jix maa aa'ñdham no'ch bham dhi' jix duu gu Dabii; jano' ba' dhi' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' gu Akîs guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Dabii bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel ka't bɨɨx tas tu duukam.

Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu Pilisteos jum daa'ñ vaak ja'tkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' jix aa' gu Akîs gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨɨda' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vaak ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu Akîs; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Akîs jix aa' gu Dabii; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix nukadham mo'o bɨx gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Samueel ka't jix koi bɨx gu Israeel ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dua'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Rama kiicham; gio ba' gu Sauul ka't baas gu oidha' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Na gu' na ja'p gu Pilisteos jum daa'ñ tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' gu Sunam; gio ba' gu Sauul jum daa'ñ bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' gu Gilboa.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix ñi' gu Sauul yooxi' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Sauul gu Jawatan Dios; gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix aa' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨɨtki' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Urim tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham tu'x jai'ch gu u'vɨ gu Endor juraa'n gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Sauul jix dhaas jajannulhi'ñ ka't bɨɨx gook gu chichio'ñ tɨɨtɨs mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ gu tukaa'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' soi'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' tu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' ñɨidhat gu Sauul tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu oidha' na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kooda'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Sauul guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam cham bhai' tu' ɨlhdham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi'.
Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ jano' ba'; gio ba' chɨkka tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Samueel.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu u'vɨ gu Samueel tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ gu Sauul bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' jix duu gu Sauul; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham jum i'obh; jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim buupui gu u'vɨ jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' buupui gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam duñiaꞌ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gɨ' ja'tkam na jix maat jupaabkamu'n jix bhaan dhaas guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; jano' ba' gu Sauul jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't gu Samueel guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vupui gu oidha' jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Sauul jix aa'; mi' dhɨr dhi' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; na gu' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' cham tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨɨtki'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' tu' tɨɨgim na ba' jix duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim no'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel; gio ba' na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' gu Jawatan Dios bhaamki'ñdha'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ja'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jawatan Dios oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu novɨ tu' jix maa duiñchu' gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' na ja'p tu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam i'iich guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan gu Amalek guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' gu Israeel gio bɨndak gu noobh gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu xibh boopoya' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ yooxi' gu Israeel kapbhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu noobh gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Sauul gu oidha' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix gɨ' ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim choo'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Samueel; na gu' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na gu' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' cham ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu takarui'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ suudai' u'va gu Sauul jimchu' jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu oidha' gu novɨ naak gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' gio guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook ja'tkam na tu juan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' vupui bhaan tu' gu chin gu takarui' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bham; gio ba' cham jugi; gu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨma'n bɨɨx gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; jano' ba' jix búup guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix daa bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ ga'ra' gu vaak guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu takarui' cham jabka'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan gu Sauul guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' a'lhiok guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix búup guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos jum daa'ñ bɨx vaak ja'tkam gu Apek; gio ba' tu' gu Israeel jix dhaas yooxi' ju'ñdharan suudai' buusñi gu Jesreel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn chiñia' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam chamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ gu Dabii guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix duu bɨɨx gu Akîs.

Jano' ba' gui'p chiñia' gu Pilisteos; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim xoi'kam dhi' ja'tkam gu ebreos gu Akîs jix aa' chiñia' gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii tu duukam gu Sauul gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tu' dhi' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam dhɨt gu tanoolh dhɨt guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham gaagam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' chiñia' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga pai' nɨi'ñchudat cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx no'ch guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaamki'ñdha'; na gu' bɨɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tutkɨ nɨidhidha' gu Jawatan bɨɨx ɨɨbhidham dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham dhi' gu Dabii alabaa'n guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bham; gio ba' gu Sauul naaka'n guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Dabii mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Ba' jix aa' gu Akîs jup tɨɨt gu Dabii; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix duu tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn xoi'kam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ba'k yooxi' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gaagam tu' dɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gu' gu vupui chiñia' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhai'x i'ii'ñ; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa cham bhai' gu vupui chiñia' gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu Akîs; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gaagam tu duukam dɨr gu tanoolh dhi' bɨndak bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' tu' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Akîs gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' jix duu jix bhai' gu vupui na ja'p nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gu' chiñia' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx no'ch guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' bamii' gu xibh tu' tu duukam gu Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨbiap bɨndak; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu xibh guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii gu xibh guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' jix duu jix joi'ñ gu oidha' gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu Pilisteos jix bɨɨx duu gu Jesreel.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tɨɨtɨs gu Siklag vaik gu tanoolh gu Amalek guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ saagi'ñ gu Siklag guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Siklag guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu tai.

Jano' ba' dua'ñ baabuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'vɨ mi'p dɨr jix ali' bɨɨx ka'm jix gɨ'; gu' soo'mchulhdhak guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix koi guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat baabuk tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Dabii bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ kiicham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't vaak na jix bhaan gu tai gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' na jix kavɨk na ba' jix xuaak.
Jano' ba' gook gu u'vɨ gu Dabii gu Ainoam gu Jesreelita gu Abigail ka't gu u'vɨ gu Nabal gu Karmelo gio guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Na gu' gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix duu na gu' gu ja'tkam ua'rgidhimɨk tu jiim; na gu' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ maa'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gu' gu Dabii guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Abiatar gu mar gu Aimelek; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr gu Abiatar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dhi' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨɨda' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' ta'tak gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx mi'p tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx ka'm bhi'ñbak gu Besor pai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn dhɨt.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii chɨ'ɨɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu chichio'ñ; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhi'ñbak gu Besor.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook yooxi' gu chio'ñ gu Egipkio aichdhak gu Dabii jix maa gu takarui' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim i'i gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jix maa gio guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' jix jugi guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ; na gu' cham ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu takarui' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu suudai' vaik gu tanoolh vaik gu tukaa'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' chɨkka jix duu tu' duukat jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Egipkio; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu duukam gu Amalekita guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' vaik gu tanoolh na gu' ka't ka'ook.
Na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn baasɨ'n saagi'ñ gu Kereti gu Judaa saagi'ñ gu Kaleb; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu tai gu Siklag.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios cham koo'nda' tu' kapbhai' gu noobh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mi'p guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan gu vupui bɨx mii' dhɨr gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' gu Pilisteos pai' gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' naaka'n gu Dabii dɨr mii' dhɨr gu xibh bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai gu tanoolh buimgidhak; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ biipibop guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu jiim jix ai jiboi'ññor.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Dabii bɨx gu Amalekitas guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii gook gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' jix gɨ' gu ma'nkam na ja'p ma'nkam u'uuvɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' bɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kakneer guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨx vupui bhaan am:―Ja'pji; mi' dhɨr dhi' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Dabii guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Dabii guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhi'ñbak gu Besor; gio ba' moor guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Dabii gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam tulhiiñdha' bɨɨx bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx tomaat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx gu Dabii tu ñi'ook gui'p; na gu' cham jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx no'ch cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat maa'n gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' dhagia' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu noobh guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ suudai' u'va bhaan no'ch.

Na gu' chɨkka guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam baasɨ'n tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jupaabkamu'n guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; na guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨma'n.

Jano' ba' dɨr mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka't dhi' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñi'ook na tu a'ga jir bɨx bhai' gu Israeel bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Siklag bhañ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam daraa gu Judaa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu Bet-el gu Ramot saagi'ñ mi'p gu Jattir.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu Aroer gu Sipmot mi'p gu Estemoa.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu Rakâl mi'p jɨ'dɨlh gu Jerameel mi'p jɨ'dɨlh gu Kineo.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu orma mi'p gu Kôrasaan mi'p gu Atak.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu ebroon bɨx jix duu pai' gu Dabii ka't dhi' bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx gu Israeel jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan gu Pilisteos ia'rɨ koko'kam gu kavɨk gu Gilboa.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Pilisteos gu Sauul gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jonataan gu Abinadab gu Melkîsua gu ma'nkam gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu Sauul guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix duu; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim choo'n jix duu.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul kutun kavɨk; na gu' jix buusñi gu kuchii guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; na gu' gu' kutun kavɨk cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na gu' ga'ra' choo'n; jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Sauul gu kuchii guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ kutun kavɨk gu Sauul jix koi gio guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu kuchii jix koi bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Sauul mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨɨma'n bɨɨx vaik gu ma'nkam kutun kavɨk bɨx gu chio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ baasɨ'n gu Jordaan ñɨi'ñ gu Israeel ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Sauul gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm koko'kam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jɨ'dɨlh jiboi'ññor; gio ba' gu Pilisteos tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' ka't buimgidhak gu tanoolh bai'ñpu' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat koko'kam gu ñi'ook gu Sauul vaik gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu kavɨk gu Gilboa.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ mo'o guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook; gio ba' mɨjɨ gu oidha' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan duiñxim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Astarot guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu chuukug vaak jodai gu Bet-san.
Gu' gu' tɨiñ gu Jabes gu Galaad dhi' gu Pilisteos jix duu gu Sauul.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk jix búup guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu chuukug gu Sauul gu chuukug gu ma'nkam vaak jodai gu Bet-san; gio ba' bai'ñpu' gu Jabes guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' dhaagɨk o'oo guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨtaa'n gu u'u gu Jabes guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
